Hi Elena — sorry for the trouble and thanks for the screenshot. I dug into the invite: the system sent the invite to procurement@greenharborlogistics.com but our platform attempted to associate the account with an existing billing contact record (billing@greenharborlogistics.com) that has a slightly different domain alias. That mismatch appears to trigger an extra verification step which in your case is redirecting back into the claim flow.

Immediate next steps I can take for you:
- Re-issue a fresh invite explicitly addressed to elena@greenharborlogistics.com and mark the invite to bypass billing-contact auto-lookup (temporary workaround).
- If you prefer we can update the billing contact on our side to match the procurement address; we'll need a quick confirmation email from someone in finance with the correct email.

I'll loop in Marissa and Ben from Ops to coordinate. Which option do you prefer? If you want the bypass invite, I can send it now.

Tessa
